newsitem.title: USA: Transworld Home to acquire Health Management.
newsitem.headline: Transworld Home to acquire Health Management.

text.p: Transworld Home HealthCare Inc. said Thursday it will acquire Health Management Inc., which provides pharmacy management services, for about $27.6 million and assume $28 million in debt.
Under the agreement, Transworld will offer $2.00 cash for each of Health Management's 9.3 million common shares outstanding, and pay $1 a share for about 9 million newly issued shares of the company.
Transworld has an option to acquire up to an additional 2 percent of Health Management's common stock.
Clark, N.J.-based Transworld, which provides alternate-site health care services and products, will also inject $3 million of working capital into Health Management.
Over the last 12 months, the companies had combined unaudited pro forma net sales of about $240 million.
The deal is subject to approval by Health Management stockholders and regulators, and the ability of Transworld to obtain adequate financing.
Buffalo Grove, Ill.-based Health Management's stock edged down 31.25 cents to $1.94, while Transworld rose $1 to $10.875 on Nasdaq at mid-morning.
